summary:
## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

Separate from the main session goal, run `prod-db-credential-rotation` between other work, in this exact order: check Vault; record old lease; mint replacement credential; update Kubernetes secret; restart `orders-api`; verify startup; revoke previous lease; remove temporary files.

Always use db-stg-2.

Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, causing customer 400s.

Superseded/paused: invoice pagination. Report profiling is also being carried on during an operator meeting hour.

## Ruled-out approaches
Adding an invoices index on `(customer_id, created_at)` for the slow report was ruled out because it doubled ingest write latency.

## Recent work
Invoice pagination was dropped after its tests passed. Rotation completed steps 1–3; replacement credentials are in `/run/orders-new.json`, and Kubernetes update remains pending. Report profiling found 2,417 SQL statements for a medium tenant and a large N+1 pattern in `build_summary`; profiling dominated by SQLite execution. Stripe webhook remains uninvestigated.
